title: Becky G Brings World Mental Health Day Festival to a Powerful Close in NYC & More Uplifting Moments
summary: Además, BMI impulsa a las compositoras de la música mexicana, y Lin-Manuel Miranda recibirá el Premio Corazón Latino de iHeartRadio.
body: From career milestones to new music releases to major announcements and those little important moments,  Billboard  editors highlight  uplifting moments  in Latin music. Here’s what happened in the Latin music world this week. Becky G Opens Up About Identity and Mental Health at Project Healthy Minds Event Becky G brought Project Healthy Minds’ World Mental Health Day Festival to a powerful close on Saturday (Oct. 10) in New York with an intimate conversation on identity, creativity and mental health. Moderated by NBC News correspondent Morgan Radford, the panel gave the Mexican American star space to reflect on growing up in the public eye, protecting her peace and learning to tell her story on her own terms. “The whole concept of being a role model is to model this idea of perfection, and I don’t think that is real at all,” Becky G said. “Instead of being a role model, I’ve always felt the responsibility to be a real model, which means I’m not going to have all the answers.
